definition: A positional encoding method that encodes relative position information by multiplying query and key representations by a rotation matrix.
details: RoPE combines the benefits of absolute positional encodings and relative positional encodings by implementing position information directly via complex rotation, showing decay across token distance and supporting dynamic context length scaling.
story: Think of an orchestra warming up: no single instrument carries the piece, but together they make the sound. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. The shape of the machine is half the idea. That blueprint is Rotary Position Embedding.

citation.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding
